explication: Autoswagger is a command-line security scanner that finds API specifications, tests documented endpoints for unauthenticated access, analyzes responses for sensitive or unusually large data, and reports findings. Its runtime is implemented in the single core file autoswagger.py, so the graph separates meaningful responsibilities within that file rather than implying a multi-package architecture. The README documents the full capability set; sampled source confirms endpoint dispatch and spec-fetch behavior, but not every internal call relationship.
